generation.prompt: Create one landscape 3:2 editorial semi-realistic ink and gouache illustration for Jardín, Antioquia, Colombia, a NEW INDEPENDENT composition, not copying any photograph. Draft destination hero. Show Parque El Libertador at human eye-level diagonally across its stone paved plaza, colorful traditional wooden cafe chairs and tables near the foreground edge, small garden beds and mature shade trees; the actual Basílica Menor de la Inmaculada Concepción clearly recognizable in midground: exposed dark brown-grey hand-worked stone neo-Gothic facade, TWO matching tall slim towers on either side, each ending in a pointed silvery metal spire and small cross, central pointed-gable facade with narrow Gothic arched portals and windows. Entire tower silhouettes must be in frame. Surrounding low one/two storey Antioquian buildings white walls with colorful doors and wood balconies, green Andean hills at distance. Restrained natural bright blue sky, stone neutral browns, varied chair reds/blues, detailed visible ink marks and gouache texture, realistic illustrated architecture, modest few cartoon-like people with proper faces and bodies; no text, logos, watermarks, no yellow color wash, no giant tropical palms, no modern skyline, no sea, no spherical-head stick figures. This is an illustrated draft of an actual place, not a photograph; do not add unverified landmarks or invented monumental fountains. Keep composition different from individual church close-up attraction card. Use factual descriptions from Colombia Travel of hand-cut stone neo-Gothic twin towers and Parque El Libertador only; no third-party image supplied.
